display_long_description:
A stylish, simple, and easy-to-use calculator with a hidden feature

A stylish calculator app with a design based on black.
We have simply gathered the functions needed for daily calculations, pursuing true ease of use.

[Main Features]
・Basic Functions: Arithmetic operations (+, -, ×, ÷), percentage calculations, and sign switching (+/-).
・Usability: Equipped with haptic feedback (vibration) when buttons are pressed.
・Design: Uses an eye-friendly dark mode and a highly readable programming font.
・Precision: Supports input of up to 15 digits, designed to minimize calculation errors.

[Hidden Feature]
Tired of calculating? How about a little break?
If you tap the "=" button 5 times rapidly while in the initial state (when "0" is displayed), a hidden game mode will launch.
Please enjoy a simple yet engrossing side-scrolling action game.
(Game Controls: Jump with "0", Return to calculator with "AC")

Making daily calculations a little more fun.
We hope you download and make use of it.
